# Requirements Quality Gate Checklist: IMAP Spam Watcher

**Purpose**: Formal release-gate validation of requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) across integration, security, reliability, observability, and configuration — used by the author for a thorough self-review before handoff.
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defining how frequently the mailbox is polled and the maximum acceptable detection latency stated as firm requirements rather than only as assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/§SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements specified for which part is used when a message contains multiple candidate original-message (`.eml`/`message/rfc822`) attachments? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Is the full set of fields the recipient must see in a verdict reply explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are reply/error-email presentation requirements (subject-line format and language/localization) defined? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-008/§FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK005 Is "not-yet-processed message" defined precisely given the delete-after-send model (what marks a message as pending)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001/§FR-011]
- [x] CHK006 Are whitelist matching semantics unambiguous (full-address vs substring match, case sensitivity, handling of multiple `From` addresses)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Are the retry bounds expressed as exact, testable values rather than "approximately 3 attempts over roughly 1–2 minutes"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010/§FR-016]
- [x] CHK008 Is the presentation of "confidence" in the reply specified with a defined format/units (e.g., 0–1 vs percentage)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK009 Can "visually emphasized / color-coded verdict" be objectively verified from the requirements as written? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Is the "exactly once" statement reconciled consistently across the exactly-once requirement, the acknowledged duplicate-reply window, and the "under normal operation" success-criterion qualifier? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011/§SC-003/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are reply-addressing rules (Reply-To when present, else From) applied consistently to both verdict replies and error notifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007/§FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Does every setting referenced elsewhere in the spec (poll interval, retry bounds) also appear in the configuration requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK013 Is sender terminology ("From-header address", "original sender", "requester") used consistently and mapped to a single defined concept? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/§FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Are all success criteria (SC-001..SC-009) measurable and free of implementation detail? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK015 Does each functional requirement trace to at least one success criterion or acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Spec §FR/§SC]
- [x] CHK016 Is the 2-minute reply target qualified with the "normal operating conditions" it assumes (detector latency, mailbox availability)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Are acceptance scenarios defined for each user story's failure/alternate paths, not just the happy path? [Coverage, Spec §US1-§US4]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are requirements complete and unambiguous for the primary flow (whitelisted forward → verdict reply)? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK019 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for both content sources (attached original vs. received body)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK020 Are exception-flow requirements defined for each detector outcome (400, 413, 500, 502, timeout/unreachable)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010; Contract spam-detector-api]
- [x] CHK021 Are recovery-flow requirements defined for a container restart that occurs mid-processing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011/§FR-012/§SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the outgoing-mail-server-unavailable path, including behavior when detector retries are exhausted but no notification can be sent? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-016/Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for empty extracted content prior to a detector call? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for content exceeding the detector's maximum allowed size? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; Contract 413]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for malformed/unparseable MIME where the sender is not identifiable? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined to prevent reply loops when the monitored mailbox also receives the service's own outbound mail? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a whitelisted message that contains no usable text at all (no body and no attachment)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Integration & External Dependencies

- [x] CHK028 Are the detector request headers (`x-functions-key`, `x-openai-api-key`, optional `x-openai-model`) and `text/plain` body specified as requirements, not only in the contract doc? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005/§FR-006]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for interpreting the detector's `isError`/`errorMessage` envelope even on a 200 response? [Gap, Spec §FR-008; Contract spam-detector-api]
- [x] CHK030 Is the bring-your-own OpenAI-key dependency documented and validated as an assumption tied to the external API contract? [Assumption, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for handling an unexpected/undocumented detector status code? [Gap, Coverage]

## Security & Privacy Requirements

- [x] CHK032 Are the specific secret values that must never be logged or persisted explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK033 Do requirements keep secrets and full message content out of error notifications (not just logs)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010/§FR-014]
- [x] CHK034 Is the whitelist's security intent (abuse/reflection prevention) backed by a testable requirement, including consideration of spoofed `From` addresses? [Clarity, Spec §US2/§FR-003]
- [x] CHK035 Are data-retention requirements for email content addressed, given delete-after-send and the no-persistence assumption? [Gap, Assumption]

## Reliability & Failure-Handling Requirements

- [x] CHK036 Is the boundary between "transient" (retryable) and "deterministic" (non-retryable) failures defined unambiguously enough to test? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK037 Is the ordering guarantee "delete only after a successful send" stated as a verifiable requirement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011]

## Observability Requirements

- [x] CHK038 Are the specific per-message log events and fields enumerated so the SC-008 traceability outcome is objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017/§SC-008]
- [x] CHK039 Are requirements defined for logging startup and IMAP/SMTP/detector connectivity events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Configuration & Deployment Requirements

- [x] CHK040 Are validation rules for each configuration setting specified (required vs optional, formats, and behavior on invalid config)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013; Contract configuration]
- [x] CHK041 Is the always-on/auto-restart expectation expressed as a testable deployment requirement rather than an implementation note? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK042 Is the CC-list parsing rule (semicolon-separated, whitespace trimmed, empty entries ignored) specified precisely enough to test? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Ambiguities

- [x] CHK043 Are all stated assumptions (polling, transport security, single mailbox/detector, modest volume) explicitly validated or flagged for confirmation? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK044 Is the out-of-scope boundary (rate limiting, multi-mailbox, UI) unambiguous and non-conflicting with the functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
